scope: Citation integrity and compact reader only; existing admission policy is unchanged.
initial_representation: Exact retained Git blob bytes with half-open byte selectors; source/repository/path/revision/profile identity checked separately from content equality.
correspondence: Same immutable occurrence is the only initial justified transport profile. Text search, even unique and exhaustive, is diagnostic only; other transformations and deletion without sufficient evidence remain unknown.
coverage: Unavailable enumeration is distinct from a measured exhaustive empty domain. Search coverage and presentation completeness remain separate.

citation-lean.meaning: Clean Lean build, complete registered axiom audit, executable examples, kernel-checked concrete mutant counterexamples and rejection at intended safety declarations. Mathematical fidelity is reviewed separately. Not full WF08 or a Rust refinement proof.

production_obligations.V22: Actual selector, binding, alias, cursor, correspondence, coverage and reuse predicates, checked conversions and complete caller mapping.
production_obligations.native: Contained retained Git/blob acquisition, immutable storage, current authorization and real CLI/stdio entrypoints; storage-dependent integration requires P01O/WF24.
production_obligations.empirical: Complete repeated-workflow correctness and actual token/latency comparisons against competent targeted search plus kctx.

gate_policy: No mixed-policy WF32/WF33 activation or renaming. A component receipt cannot close existing WF08, P05, P09, P11 or release. Full feature integration requires all relevant production, protocol and native obligations.
weft: External interpreter uses the same Writfold stdio interface as agents; no Weft-only opcodes, recipe VM or bypass.
